changelog:
Initial release of doubao-ai-toolkit.

- Provides CLI access to ByteDance Doubao AI models: image generation, video generation, TTS, ASR, chat, search, and embedding.
- Includes core commands: `coze-coding-ai` (all-in-one), `seedream` (image), and `seedance` (video).
- Detailed install and authentication instructions using environment variables or CLI options.
- Offers comprehensive command templates and usage examples for all supported features.
- Documents available models, speaker IDs, parameter options, and advanced usage notes.
summary: 字节跳动豆包 AI 工具包。 用一行指令调用：图像生成、视频生成、语音合成(TTS)、语音识别(ASR)、文本对话、联网搜索、Embedding。 核心命令：coze-coding-ai（全能 CLI）、seedream（图像生成专精）、...
